settings.text: Works with the Apple Find My app · iPhone only

Two 2 mm tracker cards that slip into your wallet and show up in Find My on your iPhone. Ring them when they're lost nearby, get an alert when you leave them behind, and see their last location on the map.

settings.rows:

settings.heading: Compatibility
settings.content:
Works with iPhone and iPad running iOS 14.5 or later, through the built-in Find My app. Each card links to one Apple ID at a time; to give one to someone else, remove it from your Find My first.

Not compatible with Android.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content:
Free Aramex delivery anywhere in South Africa. Order before 13:00 on a weekday and we dispatch the same day. Expect it in 2–4 working days in main centres, a little longer in outlying areas. You'll get a tracking number by email.

30-day returns. Changed your mind? Send it back unused within 30 days for a full refund. 12-month warranty on faulty cards. Full details

settings.fallback_alt: Tracker card measuring 85 by 54 millimetres and 2 millimetres thin
settings.heading: Fits in a card slot. Barely there.
settings.text: The same size as your bank card (85 × 54 mm) and only 2 mm thick. Slide it in behind your cards and forget it's there, until you need it.

settings.fallback_alt: Left-behind notification for a wallet on the pavement
settings.heading: Walk away without it and your iPhone will say so.
settings.text: Turn on Notify When Left Behind for the card in Find My. Add trusted places like home, and you'll only be alerted when it matters.

settings.title: Switch it on
settings.text: Press the button on the card. It beeps to let you know it's ready to pair.

settings.title: Add it to Find My
settings.text: Open Find My → Items → + → Add Other Item and follow the prompts.

settings.title: Done
settings.text: Name it, slip it into your wallet, and it shows up on the map next to your other Apple devices.

settings.eyebrow: Set up in about a minute
settings.heading: How it works
settings.note: Needs an iPhone or iPad with the Find My app (iOS 14.5 or later). Not compatible with Android.

settings.question: Does it work with Android?
settings.answer: No. It works with Apple's Find My app only, so you'll need an iPhone or iPad running iOS 14.5 or later.

settings.question: Are there any monthly fees?
settings.answer: No. You pay once. Find My is free and already on your iPhone.

settings.question: How do I charge it?
settings.answer: Each card has a built-in rechargeable battery. The quick-start guide in the box shows you how to charge it, and one charge lasts for months of normal use.

settings.question: Can I use both cards on one iPhone?
settings.answer: Yes. Add each card separately in Find My and give them different names, like "Wallet" and "Laptop bag".

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Weekday orders placed before 13:00 leave us the same day. Aramex delivers in 2–4 working days to main centres, slightly longer to outlying areas. Delivery is free.

settings.question: What if it's faulty?
settings.answer: Every card has a 12-month warranty. WhatsApp or email us and we'll sort out a repair, replacement or refund, and cover the courier costs.
